_comment: Hand-written guide data. Levels are suggestions, not exact Hypixel gates. Copy this file to config/skyblockprogression/guide.json to edit it; that copy is used instead. Requirement types: SKILL, HEART_OF_THE_MOUNTAIN, GARDEN_LEVEL, DUNGEON_SKILL, DUNGEON_TIER.

FARMING.name: The Barn
FARMING.info: Wheat, carrots and potatoes while you start out.

FARMING.name: Mushroom Desert
FARMING.info: Sugar cane, cactus, mushrooms and cocoa, plus Trevor's animal hunts.

FARMING.name: Your Garden
FARMING.info: Farm one crop per plot with your crop tool. Jacob's Contests give medals and tickets.

FARMING.name: Garden (pest hunting)
FARMING.info: Keep farming and kill pests with your vacuum for extra drops.

MINING.name: Gold Mine
MINING.info: Coal, iron and gold with your first pickaxe.

MINING.name: Deep Caverns
MINING.info: Lapis, redstone, emerald and diamond layers as you go deeper.

MINING.name: Dwarven Mines
MINING.info: Mithril and commissions. This is where you unlock Heart of the Mountain.

MINING.name: Crystal Hollows
MINING.info: Gemstones and rare Divan's parts. Needs a Crystal Hollows pass.

MINING.name: Glacite Tunnels
MINING.info: Glacite, tungsten and umber, plus fossils in Glacite Mineshafts.

COMBAT.name: Hub Graveyard
COMBAT.info: Zombies at night. Start Revenant Horror (Zombie Slayer) here.

COMBAT.name: The End
COMBAT.info: Endermen and Zealots, and Voidgloom Seraph (Enderman Slayer).

COMBAT.name: Crimson Isle
COMBAT.info: Blazes, Inferno Demonlord (Blaze Slayer), faction quests and Kuudra.

FORAGING.name: The Park
FORAGING.info: All the basic log types. More of the Park opens as you level up.

FORAGING.name: Galatea
FORAGING.info: Mangrove and fig trees, and the Fig Hew, Figstone and Helix gear.

FISHING.name: Hub water
FISHING.info: Fish anywhere in the Hub for your first sea creatures.

FISHING.name: Backwater Bayou
FISHING.info: Bayou sea creatures and good early fishing XP.

FISHING.name: Crimson Isle lava
FISHING.info: Lava sea creatures and Trophy Fish. Bring a Magma Rod or better.

HUNTING.name: Galatea
HUNTING.info: Track and catch creatures for shards with your Huntaxe, Lasso and Net.

DUNGEONS.name: Floor 3
DUNGEONS.info: The Professor. Adaptive gear drops here.

DUNGEONS.name: Floor 5
DUNGEONS.info: Livid. Shadow Assassin gear drops here.

DUNGEONS.name: Floor 6
DUNGEONS.info: Sadan. Necromancer and Giant's Sword drops.

DUNGEONS.name: Floor 7
DUNGEONS.info: Necron. Wither armor and Necron's Handle.

DUNGEONS.name: Master Mode
DUNGEONS.info: Harder floors with the best dungeon loot.

money.name: Bazaar flipping
money.info: Use the Bazaar Flipper mod to find the best flips for your budget.

money.name: Minions
money.info: Place minions on your island and sell what they make on the Bazaar.

money.name: Farming crops
money.info: Farm the Barn and sell enchanted crops.

money.name: Zombie and Spider slayer
money.info: Revenant and Tarantula slayer bosses and their drops.

money.name: Mithril mining
money.info: Mine Mithril and do commissions in the Dwarven Mines.

money.name: Foraging on Galatea
money.info: Chop mangrove and fig logs with your foraging gear.

money.name: Sea creature fishing
money.info: Fish up sea creatures and sell their drops.

money.name: Garden farming
money.info: Farm your best crop in the Garden and sell to the Bazaar. Pests add rare drops.

money.name: Zealots and Enderman slayer
money.info: Zealots in The End for Summoning Eyes, and Voidgloom Seraph drops.

money.name: Gemstone mining
money.info: Mine gemstones in the Crystal Hollows with a gemstone drill.

money.name: Dungeon floors 5 to 7
money.info: Run floors for chest loot and essence.

money.name: Glacite mining
money.info: Tungsten, umber and glacite in the Glacite Tunnels and Mineshafts.

money.name: Blaze slayer and Crimson Isle
money.info: Inferno Demonlord and Crimson Isle mobs.

money.name: Kuudra
money.info: Kuudra runs for Kuudra teeth and Crimson armor. Also needs Crimson Isle reputation.

money.name: Master Mode dungeons
money.info: The most profitable dungeon runs once you can clear Floor 7.
